text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Thanks for coming to see
me!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Thanks for coming to see
me!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it was great! It always feels so good
to run!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Still, I can't let myself be content.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: I'll keep going full blast until everyone is chasing after me!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Great job! Today's race was so exciting!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: It felt like your strength, your drive, your everything has improved since the previous race.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
That's right! Most of all, you looked like
you were
having a lot of fun!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Teehee! I'm glad to see I got the
message across!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
But next time, I'll show you an even
better race!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
The race coming up is considered the
most
prestigious of the year, after all...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
It's a huge spectacle, and I'm going to
give
everyone a race that'll have them
glued to their
seats!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm really looking forward to it!
Best of
luck!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
After making it through some big races,

Марузенски's next goal is the Japanese

Derby—the pinnacle of racing!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
